wiring.proof: A connection jumping three color-block boundaries can be replaced by two shorter adjacent-block connections without uncovering endpoints. An inverted left/right pair inside one block admits a strict 2(v-u) saving, forcing a left prefix and right suffix with at most one overlapping point. The separated-groups edge-cover cost has max(k,j) gap crossings and is attained by boundary stars. min(D[q-k],D[q-k+1]) represents zero/one overlap. Splitting k<=j and k>=j yields two prefix/suffix minima; each monochromatic block is scanned at two adjacent boundaries, so total linear time after merging.

train.proof: Remove the opponent attractor of the complement of the player charging attractor. Remaining player vertices retain one edge and remaining opponent vertices retain all edges, so the subgame stays total. On the final set, fixed rank-decreasing choices return to charging; on removed sets a lexicographically decreasing removal-round/rank strategy reaches a charging-free trap. Both winning strategies select one permanent edge per owned vertex, meeting the first-visit contract. Queue/counter attractors give O(NM) for M>=N, not a production-performance claim about the research Python sets.

independentOracle.oracle: Enumerate complete fixed outgoing switches, group by player1 strategy, take exists(player1)forall(player0), literally follow eventual cycle. No attractor, no first-visit recursive minimax.

simurgh.proof: A fundamental-cycle exchange gives membership(e)-membership(f) using an actual spanning-tree query. Unknown reference edges are each queried once, with at most one anchor query per processed cycle; an all-zero-difference cycle must have all memberships zero, because all one would be a hidden-tree cycle. Remaining reference bridges are one. Complete any forest using known reference edges and subtract their known contribution. Incident stars yield hidden degrees; binary search an active leaf star to recover its one hidden edge.

independentForestOracle.oracle: Independent DFS cycle/connectivity on every candidate forest and its reference-tree completion, then literal intersection count; no author DSU forest validator.

books.proof: Sum|i-p[i]| is forced book-carrying distance. Cycle splicing is free only after an actual vertex of that cycle lies inside the reachable interval. For a closed interval, compare the paid left/right expansions to their first cycle crossing the opposite boundary: either both exist and produce the same closure, or neither exists and both outside costs are necessary. Until that crossing the two frontier scans are disjoint, so mixing directions cannot beat the cheaper side before the common future state. Advance only newly included endpoints for a linear scan.
